settings.heading: Three materials, one pair of hands

settings.title: Concrete
settings.text: Cast by hand, cured for seven days, then sealed inside and out. It takes pigment unevenly, which is the point.

settings.title: Clay
settings.text: Speckled stoneware and terracotta, thrown on the wheel and fired twice. The throwing ridges stay.

settings.title: Resin
settings.text: Poured in layers over three days. Every piece sets a little differently, so no two match.
